Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

hobby — an activity you enjoy in free time. Example: My hobby is photography.
sport — a physical game or activity. Example: I do sport every week.
game — an activity with rules you play. Example: I play games with my friends.
music — sounds made with voices or instruments. Example: I love listening to music.
read — to look at words and understand them. Example: I love reading in the evening.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What is your hobby?
• Do you like sport?
• How often do you ...?
• I usually ... twice a week.
• Most students ...

Grammar focus: Like / Love / Hate + -ing.
Ask survey questions with the present simple: What is your hobby? Do you like sport? How often do you play? Answer with frequency adverbs: I usually play twice a week.
